notes: Same divisions as vv. 3–4 for the הֲמִבְּלִי clause (Is → הַ, it added, because → מִן, בְּלִי unrepresented, there is no → אֵין, that added) and the bed clause (whither → אֲשֶׁר שָׁם, suffix unrepresented).
There came up a man: presentative there joins the finite verb (rule 17); turn again keeps again with שׁוּב (rule 44).
